snippet.title: My Indie Game: Gutfarm
snippet.description: Gutfarm is a top-down 2D tower defense farming game. You’ll harness crops’ unique abilities to fend off waves of alien creature invasions. Develop your farm, upgrade defenses, and strategically deploy your crops—every crop is vital for both survival and counterattacks!
